description: fz has no is_function (no lib definition, no guard). Elixir's Kernel.is_function/1 and /2 (arity) are guards. Needed by Macro.escape to refuse a closure. Done when: both are guards and functions, match Elixir on interp/run/build for closures, captures (local and remote) and non-functions, via an oracle fixture.
title: is_function/1 and is_function/2 answer whether a value is a function
